facts.text: Variant management is the discipline of tracking every version of a machine, its sensors and its settings so that evidence is attached to the correct variant and changes do not silently invalidate another variant.
facts.quote: Variant management is the discipline of keeping track of every version of the machine, its sensors and its settings, so that the right evidence is attached to the right variant and a change to one does not silently invalidate another.
